LanguageData.SDS.IntroNotice.Label: Super Storage: Operation Guide
LanguageData.SDS.IntroNotice.Text:
Research "Super Storage Basics" to unlock the Super Dimensional Core and anchor the space; research "Advanced Super Storage" to unlock the Super Dimensional Anchor for storing and withdrawing items across the colony; research "Precision Super Storage" to unlock the Super Dimensional Stabilizer and raise the capacity of super dimensional space.
Research "Precision Super Storage" to unlock the Super Dimensional Basic Chip; once implanted, the colonist and attached mechanoids can access the stored stock at any time while on the map with a Super Dimensional Core. Research "Advanced Precision Super Storage" to unlock the Super Dimensional Advanced Chip; once implanted, the colonist and attached mechanoids can access the stored stock anywhere at any time once the space is anchored, and can draw directly on super dimensional storage when trading with other colonies.
Click "Super Storage" at the bottom right (default hotkey: C) to open the Super Storage panel. Select an entry to output it (default hotkey: Q) or use it (default hotkey: E); when choosing an amount, confirm with Enter / middle mouse button.
The mod settings screen lets you customize the mod's freedom, including zero power consumption, immunity to solar flares, increased capacity, and forcing weapons/apparel virtualization.

LanguageData.SDS.Settings.ZeroMeansNoPower: Note: a power draw of 0 means no power is needed (no grid connection required).
LanguageData.SDS.Settings.ExcludeFromWealth: Exclude super dimensional storage from colony wealth (off by default = counted)
LanguageData.SDS.Settings.PlayerFactionOnlyAccess: Only the player faction can use super dimensional storage (off by default)
LanguageData.SDS.Settings.PlayerFactionOnlyAccess.Con: When on, wild animals, raiders, visitors, prisoners and quest lodgers can no longer withdraw, carry, wear, equip, ingest or use medicine from the grid. Player colonists, mechs and colony animals are unaffected. This only restricts access; it does not change stock counts, wealth, the resource counter or visibility. Enable?
LanguageData.SDS.Settings.HighestStoragePriority: Ignore priority for super dimensional storage
LanguageData.SDS.Settings.HighestStoragePriority.Conf:
When on, the grid counts as the highest-priority storage for all storable items.
· Storable items in stockpiles and storage buildings are hauled into the grid automatically. · Mutually exclusive with "Allow priority outflow": enabling this turns outflow off. · Contents of transporters, hoppers, caskets and other owner-based containers are not covered. · Turning this off restores vanilla priority behavior.
Enable?
LanguageData.SDS.Settings.AllowPriorityOutflow.Title: Confirm allow priority outflow
LanguageData.SDS.Settings.AllowPriorityOutflow.Confir:
When on, super dimensional storage re-enters vanilla hauling candidates: colonists will haul stock out only when a storage container with strictly higher priority that accepts the item exists.
· Only available stock (total − reserved) is used; items reserved by trade, caravan or bills are never hauled out. · Destination cell / container and mirror-job reservations still follow vanilla rules. · Mutually exclusive with "Ignore priority": enabling this turns it off. · Takes effect within 30 ticks; turning it off removes candidates within 30 ticks. · Player faction only.
Enable?
LanguageData.SDS.Settings.ForceGearVirtualDesc: Off by default; when on, ordinary weapons/apparel no longer enter preserved mode because of art, color, style or charges.
LanguageData.SDS.Settings.ForceGearVirtual.Title: Confirm forced virtualization
LanguageData.SDS.Settings.ForceGearVirtual.Confirm: This immediately converts convertible weapons/apparel in storage into virtual entries and permanently discards color, style, art (including generated titles/authors) and shield charges; shield belts recharge when withdrawn. This cannot be undone, and turning the switch off will not restore them. Only ordinary items are converted; quest items, relics, persona weapons, unique weapons, generated names, biocoded items, corpse-worn apparel, fuel and CE magazines stay preserved. Close trade, caravan and transport windows first. Continue?
LanguageData.SDS.Settings.ForceGearVirtual.ConfirmNoG: Not in a game: no stock will be converted, and loading a save will not auto-convert. Re-enable inside the save or withdraw and re-store the items. Enable anyway?
LanguageData.SDS.Settings.ForceGearVirtual.Blocked: Close trade, caravan or transport windows before enabling forced virtualization.
